description: This file declares the class 'nl80211_client_dummy' which is a dummy implementation of the 'nl80211_client' interface used for testing purposes within the bwl namespace. It includes method declarations for managing WiFi interface, radio, station info, and various wireless operations.

classes.name: nl80211_client_dummy
classes.description: A dummy subclass of 'nl80211_client' used for testing, providing stub implementations of wireless management functions.

methods.name: get_interfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of wireless interface names.

methods.name: get_interface_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specified interface, such as MAC address and SSID.

methods.name: get_radio_info
methods.description: Retrieves radio capabilities and supported channels.

methods.name: get_sta_info
methods.description: Provides dummy station information given an interface and MAC address.

methods.name: get_survey_info
methods.description: Returns fixed survey information for testing, especially for 2.4GHz channels.

methods.name: set_tx_power_limit
methods.description: Sets the transmit power limit for a radio interface.

methods.name: get_tx_power_dbm
methods.description: Retrieves the current transmit power in dBm for a radio interface.

methods.name: add_key
methods.description: Adds a security key for a specified interface.

methods.name: add_station
methods.description: Manually associates a station with an interface, given association request data.

methods.name: get_key
methods.description: Retrieves key information for an interface.

methods.name: send_delba
methods.description: Sends a DELBA (de-allocate block acknowledgment) frame to a station.
